d: In this video, Firstpost explains how US President Donald Trump is approaching the 2026 US midterm elections amid growing concerns over election integrity, Republican control of Congress, and his response to a possible Democratic victory. Trump says he will accept the election results only if they are 'honest', raising questions about potential election challenges and recounts. Firstpost's Washington correspondent Nick Harper examines what a Democratic victory could mean for Trump’s domestic agenda, executive powers, and US foreign policy, including the possibility of renewed military…
